events.arguments: {"style":{"prompt":"Create a gentle, realistic 15-second silent short film in a leafy garden. Preserve the identities of the woman in @woman and the man in @man throughout. She has shoulder-length dark curly hair and wears her gray knit sweater; he has short gray hair, light stubble and wears his gray crewneck shirt.
